title: Selected Topics in Israel Studies; The Origins of Modern Israeli Political Thought
description: This course examines the historical evolution and diverse ideologies of the Zionist movement, from its 19-th century origins to the creation of Israel. Students explore key thinkers, debates, and texts that shaped Zionist thoughts, its responses to modernity and antisemitism, and its impact on Jewish identity and Middle Eastern politics, leadiing to the form ation of the State of Israel.
